# Vici SaskStartupSolutions

Bookkeeping, T2 corporate tax filing administration, and Saskatchewan ISC Registry administration for startups and growing companies in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan. Every engagement starts with a free, no-obligation introduction appointment.

## Pages
- Home: overview, featured services, brand story, founder introduction.
- Services: detailed descriptions of Bookkeeping, T2 Corporate Filing Administration, ISC Registry Administration, and the All in One Basic Service Package.
- Booking: service menu, appointment booking flow, downloadable PDF intake forms per service.
- Staff: founder profile for Patrick Vachon.
- Contact Us: phone 1 (306) 960-0091, email Saskstartupsolutions@viciconsulting.ca, address 539 Avenue I N, Saskatoon, SK S7L 2G9, hours Monday–Sunday 8:00 a.m. – 8:00 p.m., contact form.
- FAQ: common questions about appointments, documents, quotes, T2 timelines, and ISC Registry.
- Blog: articles on bookkeeping, corporate tax filing, and registry compliance for Saskatchewan startups.

## Notes
- No prices are published; quotes are provided after a free introduction appointment.
- Intake forms are emailed to saskstartupsolutions@viciconsulting.ca.
